artworks.title: Perseus Turning Phineus and His Followers to Stone
artworks.description: After Giordano — Perseus raising Medusa's head at the wedding, Phineus and his men freezing mid-assault.

artworks.title: Phineus Attacking Perseus at the Wedding
artworks.artist: Unknown (after the antique / LACMA collection print)
artworks.description: Antique-derived attack — Phineus storming the bridal feast, the brawl Ovid inserts after Andromeda's rescue.

artworks.title: Phineus Interrupts the Wedding of Perseus and Andromeda
artworks.description: Dutch Ovid cycle — Phineus interrupting Perseus and Andromeda's wedding, Metamorphoses Book 5 as narrative strip.

artworks.title: Phineus Interrupting the Wedding of Perseus and Andromeda
artworks.description: Van Wijnen's interruption — the uncle's claim on the bride answered by the Gorgon's stare.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid pauses the wedding feast so Perseus can tell the Gorgon's story — the inset that became the Medusa digression of Western art.

popCulture.title: Perseus
popCulture.description: The hero at Andromeda's feast, Gorgon's head still a weapon — narrative as the pause before Phineus' brawl.
